The cluster_pca_issuer manifest creates an AWSPCAClusterIssuer custom resource, whose CRD is installed by the Kubernetes add-ons module (including the AWS Private CA issuer). Without this dependency, Terraform may apply the custom resource before that CRD exists.

The cluster_pca_issuer manifest configures an ACM PCA authority that is still in PENDING_CERTIFICATE until its CA certificate is associated. Its ARN reference only orders it after authority creation, not after activation; it should wait for the certificate association.

The explicit depends_on from the managed node group to its IAM role duplicates the implicit dependency: node_role_arn references aws_iam_role.managed_ng. Terraform already orders the node group after that role.

The autoscaling group already depends transitively on its IAM instance profile through the launch-template module configuration, which references aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng. The direct explicit depends_on duplicates that ordering.

The autoscaling group's launch-template configuration already depends transitively on the IAM instance profile, and that profile references aws_iam_role.self_managed_ng. The explicit direct dependency on the role therefore duplicates an existing dependency path.

The aws_provider_config manifest explicitly depends on aws_provider and also on wait_30_seconds, which itself depends on aws_provider. The direct dependency is redundant because the timed-wait dependency already orders it after the provider manifest.
